name: review-gate
description: Independent SHA-pinned GitHub pull-request review using the live Tracer Review Gate contract, exact-head evidence, current CI/readiness checks, and a comment-only canonical verdict.

interface.longDescription: Review a GitHub pull request as a disposable independent reviewer. Reconstruct intent and evidence from live GitHub state, apply the current Tracer Review Gate contract, verify exact-head CI/readiness, and emit a SHA-bound canonical verdict without taking merge or implementation authority.
defaultPrompt: Review this GitHub pull request with Review Gate. Do not publish unless I explicitly ask you to publish.
Run Review Gate on this PR from live GitHub state and return the canonical SHA-pinned Review Record.
Re-review this PR independently from live GitHub state. Ignore conclusions from earlier review conversations.
